lenses.name: Alpha public interface deletion test
lenses.guide: Review the alpha extension's public interface for one global simplification. There is no backward-compatibility requirement before the first stable release. Preserve current extension behavior, but minimize what callers must know. Use module, interface, implementation, depth, seam, adapter, leverage, and locality precisely. Apply the deletion test to exported wrappers, helper interfaces, and pass-through modules. Report one concrete opportunity where deleting or narrowing an interface removes knowledge rather than moving it to callers. Prefer fewer public concepts and one obvious extension entry route. Do not report naming, formatting, missing types, or a small local defect. Do not add an abstraction.
